description: Frozen research shadow model: coefficients relating a reading to log10 of the EA's acetone-extract chlorophyll result (determinand 7887), fitted on seen 2021-2026 pairs, for prospective comparison only. Not a measurement, not shown on the site, not validated.
values_unit: log10 of the EA Water Quality Archive result for determinand 7887 (chlorophyll, acetone extract)
reference_note: the fallback: the value a sample gets when a model has no reading (the lake-mean reference over the paired rows)
